## Why this matters
PR #326 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-15 without closing its R81 audit findings. This issue tracks the outstanding follow-up work. Feature is behind `FEATURE_PUSH_TO_EXISTING` (default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the PR is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **F1 (P1)** Dispatcher-claim race: per-drop `update` WHERE lacks `status:'pending'` check-and-set — `src/packages/package-contents.service.ts:647-668` — fix: add `status: 'pending'` predicate to the atomic `update` WHERE clause; a sibling dispatcher claim mid-tx can otherwise overwrite a dispatching row undetected
- [ ] **F2 (P2)** Bulk write endpoint has no explicit `@Throttle` bucket — falls through to global default — `src/packages/package-contents.controller.ts:126-129` — fix: add a mutation-specific `@Throttle` ceiling appropriate for bulk write cost; add metadata regression pin
- [ ] **F3 (P2)** Response contract is TypeScript-only with no Zod `.strict()` parse fence — `src/packages/package-contents.service.ts:471-475`; `package-contents.dto.ts:283-295` — fix: add `PushToExistingResponseSchema` Zod `.strict()` and parse before returning
- [ ] **F4 (P3)** Bulk push records only a transient `logger.log` with no durable `AuditService` entry for this high-impact coach action — `src/packages/package-contents.service.ts:678-680` — fix: record a durable audit entry via `AuditService` for each bulk push operation

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audit + post-merge re-audit complete. Findings list above is verified against current `main`.
